Sam: Quick sync 1 0   playground streaming UX — compact controls and token visibility.
Sam: Issue: when streams stall we append lots of tiny fragments. Users think it's stuck. Proposal: collapse trailing fragments into a single 'stream paused' chip with a small token count and actions.
Jo: Love collapsing. For screen readers we must not keep reading fragment-by-fragment. Suggest aria-live=polite for fragments and emit one announcement on pause: 'Stream paused, 28 tokens buffered'.
Tara: For controls placement: option 1 = tiny floating toolbar at right (Replay / Stop / Copy), option 2 = inline micro-actions under bubble, option 3 = kebab menu. I lean floating for long messages and inline for short ones.
Ben: Implementation note: runtime provides buffered_token_count in stream meta, we'll expose that. For regen, we need both 'Resume' (if runtime supports continuing) and 'Regenerate' (fresh run). Copy matters.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: chip must be focusable (tabindex=0), announce once on state change, tooltips visible on focus, keyboard shortcuts documented.
Jo: Token tag: show "22 tks" next to timestamp, tooltip "Token usage for this response". Pin toggle to persist per-user. Tooltips must be keyboard accessible.
Tara: Microcopy options for the paused chip: 'Stream paused 1 tokens buffered', 'Output paused 1 queued', 'Partial output (21 tokens)'. I prefer 'Stream paused' for clarity.
Ben: Telemetry: playground.stream_paused, playground.resume_click, playground.regenerate_click. Payload: buffered_tokens, trigger (user|network|runtime).
Sam: UX details: show keyboard hint next to button when space allows: 'Regenerate (⌘↩)'. On mobile use long-press to reveal actions instead of floating toolbar.
deploy-bot: Demo branch pushed: playground/stream-chip-controls 1 preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/playground/stream-chip-controls
Sam: Thanks everyone. Ben will spike the toolbar and I will draft the tiny spec for PM review.
Jo: Suggest A/B test: toolbar vs inline actions, and 'Resume' vs 'Regenerate' wording.
Tara: Will add responsive rules: toolbar hidden under 480px, actions fall back to bottom row.
Sam: Cool, demo expected ~2069012375. Ping when ready. :rocket:
